summary: Breaking a charged create-monster wand while a Wizard is polymorphed into a hill giant subtracts eight hero HP in JavaScript instead of one. The retributive-strike branch in explode reads absent state.flags.role; C uses the canonical original role, gu.urole.mnum, and divides the Wizard hero dose by five. The first screen difference is segment 0 step 75 (C HP 41/42, JavaScript HP 34/42); RNG and cursors match throughout the recording.

Artifacts: .cache/C129-v26-break-wand-replay.mjs, .cache/C129-v26-break-wand-replay.json and .cache/C129-v26-break-wand-replay.log. At steps 73 and 74 both show HP 42/42; step 74 records rnd(12)=8; at step 75 C shows HP 41/42 and JavaScript HP 34/42. The following step has the same goblin appearance and retained HP difference.

nethack-c/upstream/src/apply.c:3971 derives dmg = obj->spe * 4; its do_break_wand call at 4038 runs the generic magical explosion before the create-monster-specific effects at 4081. The existing JavaScript call is js/apply.js:4709. apply.c:broken_wand_explode:3888-3893 supplies the other existing WAND_CLASS entry (js/apply.js:4540). No caller or wand lifecycle change is required for this defect.

nethack-c/upstream/src/explode.c:224-255 converts the negative wand type and then switches on Role_switch: PM_CLERIC, PM_MONK and PM_WIZARD divide damu by 5; PM_HEALER and PM_KNIGHT divide it by 2; other roles leave it unchanged. include/you.h:248 defines Role_switch as gu.urole.mnum. Integer truncation makes this recorded Wizard dose 8/5 = 1, irrespective of the current hill-giant polymorph form.

js/explode.js:443 instead reads state.flags?.role and compares lowercase role strings. Canonical numeric state.urole.mnum is initialized by js/role_init.js:486 and restored by js/restore.js:147; the current monster form is a different C value. Searching current js for flags.role finds only this erroneous read. Reuse the canonical original-role value and PM_* constants without adding a second role cache, lookup, RNG call or owner edit.

Only damu, the hero dose, is reduced at this early branch. Preserve original dam for monsters, item destruction, floor effects and wake radius. explode.c:608-630 applies invulnerability or physical/acid half damage later, destroys hero items with original dam, then subtracts damu from polymorph mh or ordinary uhp. Preserve that ordering and all existing messages/input boundaries.

Independently assignable narrow repair: source:explode.c:explode plus contract:retributive-wand-hero-damage; change js/explode.js and focused explode tests/fresh runner and recipes/recordings under explode.c only. Existing apply, role-init and restore owners remain read-only; no dependencies are required. This divergence fix does not establish whole explode completion or change retained specialized death/shop gaps.

Implementation evidence should pin all three /5 roles, both /2 roles, a default role, truncation below the divisor, polymorph independence, misleading flags.role and non-wand behavior; verify original monster/item damage and RNG order remain unchanged. Cite the admitted production wand-break range and independently design C-first role variations for runtime evidence.
